title: Calibration report
goal: `work-items calibrate` reports actual/baseline ratios for closed steps, grouped by size and by capability, with sample counts
acceptance: Median and range of actual/baseline per group, with n; groups under 3 samples say "too few"
Measured and stated actuals are reported separately
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: Fixtures with mixed sources and small groups

effort.basis: Released in v5.3.0 after PR #113 (CI 43068637718) and review-fix PR #114 (CI 43069622289) with independent review; baseline 1 focused day(s). No actual recorded: the three features were built together in one session, so a per-step figure would be invented.

escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner (BACKLOG-RULES, "Optional upfront feature plans")
